summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated in-tarball payload via Bun
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex `_0xXXXX` identifier scheme with per-block key/value indirection objects) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime archive from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then invokes the freshly-downloaded `bun` binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle that is itself heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array reconstruction via a shift loop, hex-only identifiers, large numeric literal table used to rebuild strings at runtime), leaving no statically observable runtime behavior. The package advertises itself as an authorization SDK; neither a Bun runtime nor a compiled math bundle is required for that purpose, and the sibling filename (`math_init.js`) does not correspond to any authorizer-SDK functionality. The combination of an obfuscated preinstall script, fetching an alternate language runtime at install time, executing a large obfuscated bundle under that runtime, and misleading filename matches the alternate-runtime-dropper delivery pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
